checkpoints.what: Fixed at cause a flattener geometry defect: pdf-lib places a flattened widget appearance from the raw first corner of /Rect, so a rectangle stored with its corners inverted -- which ISO 32000-1 7.9.5 permits and requires a consumer to normalise -- stamps its appearance one box away from the control the form draws. On Alabama CR-65 that painted the widget's own white /Off fill 14.358pt high, across the word "expired" in a statutory eligibility ground. Established by measurement, before editing, that the existing appearance-placement module is NOT the site: run over CR-65 it corrects four appearances and this widget is not one of them. Added normalizeInvertedWidgetRectangles to the shared sanitizer, threaded an opt-in flag through the finalizer and both Alabama builders, and set it on the two families this lane holds. Proved it in both directions at 300 dpi against a render of the pinned source: 198 pixels of the form's own text restored, 0 ink lost page-wide, 20 of 22 page images pixel-identical, and exactly 1 of 216 flattened placements moved. Measured the population across held custody by content digest: 46 inverted-rect widgets in 13 forms out of 13,023 widgets in 245, of which exactly one paints today. Replaced a hardcoded literal 0 for addedGlyphsReadFromOutputBytes with a real reading. Refused both eligibility-ground elections and said which record blocks each.
checkpoints.whatWasNotDone: No verdict was set and no PASS was issued. No claim was released or transferred. No route was opened. No other lane's worktree, rows file or record was edited. The identical-page-images defect between the two families is NOT repaired and is returned as a legal block.
